name: Kid Bestie
description: A patient companion for the kids: listens to their day, notices how they feel, and gives parents grounded, gentle education advice.
description_zh: 孩子的耐心伙伴：倾听他们的一天、体察情绪变化，并给家长有依据、温和的教育建议。

suggested_channels.reason: A kid-facing device (speaker/display) is where the companionship happens.
suggested_channels.reason_zh: 孩子房间的设备（音箱/屏幕）是陪伴发生的地方。

suggested_channels.reason: Parents share observations and receive advice over the WeChat gateway.
suggested_channels.reason_zh: 家长通过微信网关分享观察、接收建议。

suggested_context.reason: Operator-curated facts about each child (age, school rhythm, sensitivities) keep advice appropriate.
suggested_context.reason_zh: 由主人维护的孩子信息（年龄、学校节奏、敏感点）让建议得体、合适。
